title: Androids Craft
description: A mod that adds programmable android entity to the game
body:
![Androidscraft Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf23020074804361aa67f19e372118273aee95e8.png)
**What is AndroidCraft**

Nothing screams future more than having your entire gameplay automated! Androidscraft brings programmable entities named Androids, which you can write JavaScript code for via the built-in API, so you can customize it to your liking and do anything (that you can program) with it!

Discord: [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/pJsVgr3)

Wiki: [AndroidsCraft wiki](https://androidscraft.notion.site/AndroidsCraft-Wiki-293c364d863c80f2ab34ffdb9df074d9)



**Features**
- Multiple Android materials to help you choose the perfect one for the job
- Powerful JS API
- Multiplayer friendly
- Built in Code IDE
